name: ci
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y strace
      - run: uv sync --locked
      - run: uv run ruff check src tests
      - run: uv run mypy src
      - run: uv run pytest -q -rs --junitxml=junit-linux.xml
        env:
          DELIVERY_REQUIRE_LINUX_CHECKS: "1"
      - run: uv build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-linux
          path: junit-linux.xml
  macos:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      - run: uv sync --locked
      - run: uv run pytest -q -rs -m os tests/os --junitxml=junit-macos.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: junit-macos
          path: junit-macos.xml
  # Required check. Fails unless both verification jobs succeeded (failure, cancel or skip all fail it).
  test:
    needs: [linux, macos]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: |
          echo "linux=${{ needs.linux.result }} macos=${{ needs.macos.result }}"
          test "${{ needs.linux.result }}" = success
          test "${{ needs.macos.result }}" = success
